currentRoundInspection.scope: Complete connected Palazzo Senatorio / Tabularium exterior on the mapped parent with its narrow open court and three integral tower parts. Seven-bay ochre piazza facade with rusticated base, giant pilasters, upper windows, pedimented lower openings and a physically recessed central portal; two supported stair flights and central landing, roof balustrade, two open bell-tower stages, clock and finial. Forum side has three physical arched recesses, masonry basement, upper gallery windows, tiled roof and medieval corner tower silhouettes. Sculpture, heraldry and inscriptions use no copied artwork; small ornament is abstract.
